# Knowledge base (`data/corpus/`)

Everything in this folder (`.pdf`, `.md`, `.txt`, sub-folders included) is indexed by `python scripts/build_index.py`.

* `kb01` - `kb10` (`.md`): starter knowledge base written by the team from standard condition-monitoring practice
  (fault signatures, defect frequencies, inspection SOP, lubrication, alarm levels). Each `# heading` is cited as a
  "page" (section number).
* `kb09_synthetic_maintenance_logs.md`: **synthetic**, labelled work-order log generated by
  `scripts/generate_maintenance_logs.py` (real plant logs are confidential).
* `pdf/`: real manufacturer guides and open-access papers downloaded by `python scripts/download_corpus.py`
  (list in `data/corpus_sources.csv`, target 10-15 documents). These are **not committed to git** (copyright) -
  every team member downloads them locally. Add any further openly downloadable PDF to `pdf/` and rebuild the index.
